BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to Life in a New Light

Glass Bottle is a new kind of neighbourhood — 37 acres between Dublin Port and Dublin Bay, shaped by the people who live here. Designed for connection, built for progress, and rich with culture and experience, it brings together homes, workspaces and social life in a way that feels entirely natural.

This is city living with something extra. The energy and pace of Dublin on one side, the calm of the bay on the other. Innovation and creativity alongside wellness, nature and water. At Glass Bottle, you don't have to choose.

Lime House is our first residential building — 212 A-rated apartments across studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom layouts, each thoughtfully decorated and fully furnished. Residents enjoy access to an exceptional range of amenities: a gym and fitness studio, rooftop terraces, a private screening room, sky lounge and private dining, flexible co-working spaces, landscaped courtyards, a residents' lounge and a calendar of events curated for the community.

To find out more or book a viewing, visit glassbottle.ie/lime-house

Introducing Lime House at Glass Bottle, our first residential building consisting of studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom rental apartments built around an internal courtyard. Start your new city life here - your life in a new light

Residents' Lounges — Beautifully designed shared spaces to relax, socialise and get to know your neighbours.
Gym and Fitness Studio — A fully equipped gym and studio to support an active, balanced lifestyle — right on your doorstep.
Co-working Spaces — Thoughtfully designed flexible workspaces that make working from home easy.
Sky Lounge and Private Dining — A stunning bookable venue for dinner parties, celebrations and special occasions with a view.
Rooftop Terrace — Take in sweeping views of Dublin Bay from your own rooftop, with dedicated space for summer barbecues.
Private Screening Room — Your own residents-only cinema for film nights, sports screenings and everything in between.
Pet Friendly — A home that welcomes every member of the family, four-legged ones included.
Onsite Management Team — A dedicated team on hand to ensure everything runs smoothly, every day.
Underground Bike Storage — Convenient storage for your bikes.
Landscaped Courtyards — Beautifully planted outdoor spaces at the water's edge, perfect for fresh air and quiet moments.

Dublin on your doorstep

Sandymount Strand and the sweep of Dublin Bay to one side. Grand Canal Dock and the city centre within easy reach on the other. Glass Bottle sits at one of Dublin's most sought-after addresses — where the energy of the city meets the calm of coastal living.

Walk to Sandymount beach, cycle the coastal routes with Moby Bikes stations at your door, or jump on the 82 and S2 bus routes right outside Glass Bottle for the city centre. When you need to go further afield, a Hertz Car Share is on site. Add to that some of Dublin's best restaurants and cafés, 
and the open space of Irishtown Nature Reserve on your doorstep, and you have a location that's genuinely hard to beat. This is a place that works as hard as you do — and knows when to slow down.
Book Your Viewing Online. Weekend & Evening Appointments Available - https://glassbottle.ie/
